intro: The more you hand to Claude Code, the more often it stops to ask you something. If you're away, the work waits. Give Claude a way to reach you, and a clear rule for when to use it.

free.title: Step 1: Pick a phone service for your agent
free.body: You need a service that can send texts or place calls for an AI agent and connect to Claude as a connector or MCP server. Some agent communication services do this; developer platforms like Twilio work too. Check each service's pricing and its rules on texting and calling.

free.title: Step 2: Connect it to Claude
free.body: Add the service as a connector in Claude (or an MCP server in Claude Code), and verify your own number. Only ever let it contact you.

free.title: Step 3: Set the rules
free.body: Copy this inWhen you need a decision from me and I haven't replied in chat for 5 minutes, text me at my verified number. Say in one or two lines what you need and give me numbered options. Call me only if it's urgent. Never contact anyone else.

free.title: Step 4: Use Claude Code's notifications
free.body:
Claude Code can run a command when it's waiting for input (hooks). Point that at your phone service so you're told every time it's blocked.

Copy this inSet up a Claude Code hook that notifies me through [your phone service] whenever you're waiting for my input. Explain each step and test it once.

free.title: Step 5: Answer and keep going
free.body: Reply with the option number. Claude picks it up and continues. Keep anything risky (payments, sending to customers, deleting) as a decision you make yourself.
